comparison.objective: Move a gladhand from its dummy coupler and lock it to a trailer coupling; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Seal-face alignment, compression, and rotational lug locking with hose management versus recessed blade insertion and simultaneous tool-wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Gladhand locked and retained under a 60 N pull; candidate requires terminal exit and intact connector components, but its retention/damage thresholds are not yet measured.
comparison.reason: This is coupling installation and twist-lock verification, not selective depinning.
